topic: NSAID therapy in axSpA: continuous vs on-demand, radiographic progression

source.title: Nonsteroidal Antiinflammatory Drugs as Potential Disease-Modifying Medications in Axial Spondyloarthritis
source.whyItFits: Open review of whether NSAIDs modify radiographic progression in axial spondyloarthritis, including the continuous versus on-demand celecoxib and diclofenac trials.

whyItFits: Open review of whether NSAIDs modify radiographic progression in axial spondyloarthritis, including the continuous versus on-demand celecoxib and diclofenac trials.
coverageNote: Covers continuous versus on-demand NSAID use and radiographic progression. The two trials disagree, and that disagreement is preserved rather than resolved by adding numbers that are not in the review.
rejectedInAppHints: ASAS-EULAR 2022 was not in PMC. The in-app nr-axSpA review did not contain the continuous-versus-on-demand trial comparison.
